policy_name: OpenAPI Path-Item Parameter Inheritance and Merging Governance Policy
target_dialect: JSON Schema Draft-07 / Benchmark Tool Contract
epistemic_mandate: Parameters declared on Path Item objects apply to all sibling operation objects. Operation-level parameters override inherited parameters by unique (name, in) key, but cannot remove them. Every inherited parameter must retain explicit provenance.

key_uniqueness.definition: A parameter is uniquely identified by the tuple (name, in).
key_uniqueness.override_behavior: When an Operation defines a parameter with the same (name, in) as an inherited Path-Item parameter, the Operation-level definition takes precedence.

path_template_consistency.rule: Every template variable {var} in the path URI must correspond to exactly one in:path parameter in the merged parameter set, and vice versa.

required_path_parameters.rule: All in:path parameters must explicitly declare required: true.

prohibition_of_duplicate_operation_param.rule: An operation or path-item cannot define multiple parameters with identical (name, in) keys.

error_codes.ERR_UNRESOLVED_PARAM_REF: Parameter $ref failed to resolve within the document.
error_codes.ERR_PARAM_MISSING_SCHEMA: Parameter is missing schema definition or has invalid structure.
error_codes.ERR_PARAM_OVERRIDE_CONFLICT: Ambiguous or conflicting parameter definitions at Path-Item level.
error_codes.ERR_PATH_PARAM_MISMATCH: Mismatch between path URI template variables and in:path parameters.
error_codes.ERR_DUPLICATE_OPERATION_PARAM: Duplicate parameter declared within the same scope.
